task.description: Register/update issue ISS-0112 (GitHub #375) for schema drift where webhook_subscriptions.secret_ref column is missing in per-tenant schemas despite migration GBL-128 and GBL-133 existing. Root cause: GBL-128 only adds secret_ref to public.webhook_subscriptions, but that table was dropped from public by GBL-073. GBL-133 attempts to add it to public as well (lines 200-204) but never adds it to per-tenant schemas. Integration tests fail when accessing this column. Need a new migration to add secret_ref to webhook_subscriptions in all SCHEMA-mode tenant schemas.
